verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only the Marketing Emails API: creating, updating and retrieving emails, including batch retrieval. Contact exclusion appears only as a UI send setting. Nothing shows a contacts API for creating, updating or suppressing contacts with custom properties, or any production-scale limits, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale
